materials.content:
Charcoal on medium thick, cream moderately textured laid paper; Watermark: INGRES PMF (ITALIA)
(Source: Paper Survey researched by Judith C. Walsh and published in Lynes, 1999.)

cr_data.provenance: Estate of the artist, 1986; The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation, Abiquiu, New Mexico, 1991 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. At Whitney Mus, May 1946. . . . Note: O'Keeffe sent the wrong drawing to the exhibition and title in catalogue is not correct –– should be 'Drawing No. 12'" [refers to 1917 exhibition]. Included in 1916 exhibition on basis of Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: Drawing No. 12

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate lost inscription on original backing, "On backing by O'Keeffe, 'No. 12 – 1915 Special.' Star and initials."
titles.title: No. 12 – Special

description: Two bird-like forms curl around a central circular shape. Behind these elements are cloud shapes at the top right corner of the work as well as small rectangular strips at the bottom right and top left of the image. The rest of the background has been shaded dark gray.
imageCaption: Courtesy of National Gallery of Art.
title: No. 12 – Special
